headline: Suzaku fire worker
title: Suzaku | Fire Bird Of The Desert | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need a flaming worker in Palworld one point zero? Suzaku is a big Fire Pal that works Kindling level five. You will find it in the desert area, and its alpha is a level forty five boss. A Water team helps in the fight. Will you light up your base furnace with Suzaku? Comment below!
description: Suzaku in Palworld 1.0 is a Fire Pal with Kindling level five, found in the desert with a level forty five alpha.
